fields.whoThisIsFor: People who were exposed to a person with measles and cannot show immunity.
fields.basis: Day 5 through day 21 after the last exposure on October 18.
rules: Stay home. Do not go to school, work, child care or public places.
Do not have visitors who are not immune.
Check your temperature each morning and write it down.
fields.ifSymptoms: Call the health department first. Do not walk into a clinic or emergency room without calling.
fields.support: Food delivery and a letter for your employer or school are available through the hotline.
